metadata.title: Equidistant Affine Subspaces: Explicit Bounds, Codimension-Two Reduction, and Transverse Products
metadata.abstract: Let $\mathcal{N}(k,n)$ be the largest size of a family of affine $k$-planes in $\R^n$ at pairwise separation distance one. We develop a unified treatment of upper bounds, dimension reduction, and product constructions. Orthogonal-projection coordinates give a rank-stratified distance identity; a Veronese lifting converts its polynomial consequences into simultaneous total isotropy. Connected Nash decomposition and an analytic diagonal argument replace the linear-independence step in Höfer's three-dimensional method. An explicit cylindrical decomposition estimate yields $\mathcal{N}(k,n)\leqslant 2^{\,2^{\,3(k+1)(n-k)}}$. For configurations whose direction sums have dimension at most $k+1$, we prove the exact reduction $\mathcal{N}_{\leqslant k+1}(k,n)=\mathcal{N}(1,n-k+1)$. Every codimension-two equidistant configuration splits off a common linear factor, giving $\mathcal{N}(n-2,n)=\mathcal{N}(1,3)$. We also determine the sharp bound $2(n-k)$ when all directions lie in a fixed $(k+1)$-dimensional subspace. A transverse product construction gives multiplicative inequalities and makes $S(c)=\mathcal{N}(c-1,2c-1)$ supermultiplicative. In particular, $S(c)\geqslant 2^{c\bmod 2}7^{\lfloor c/2\rfloor}$. The structural results and constructions do not depend on the exact value of $\mathcal{N}(1,3)$.

analysis.progressType: 等距仿射子空间的界与维数约化
analysis.workSummary: 研究 Rⁿ 中两两分离距离为一的仿射 k 平面族的最大基数 N(k,n)，给出显式双指数上界 2^(2^(3(k+1)(n−k)))。对方向和维数至多 k+1 的构型证明精确约化 N_{≤k+1}(k,n)=N(1,n−k+1)，特别余维二的全部构型满足 N(n−2,n)=N(1,3)；方向均位于同一 (k+1) 维子空间时得到尖锐值 2(n−k)。
techniques: 正交投影坐标与秩分层距离恒等式
Veronese 提升与同时全迷向性
连通 Nash 分解及解析对角论证
analysis.breakthrough: 统一有限上界、共同线性因子分裂与乘积下界，使 S(c)=N(c−1,2c−1) 超乘法并有 S(c)≥2^(c mod 2)7^⌊c/2⌋。
analysis.limitations: 一般上界很大，不等于精确最大数；精确方向约化有指定方向维数条件。结构结论不依赖 N(1,3) 的确切数值，不能把约化误写成计算出该值。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
